text:
mira: deploybot preflight flagged the summarizer prompt-suite. quality-gate: FAILED. ROUGE-L down ~4.2% vs baseline, 6/50 samples with hallucinations flagged. canary HOLD requested. change window ends in ~01:30. @liz / @oliver need product decision on pin/rollback/partial rollout. deploybot details below.

deploybot: preflight-check result -> FAILED
  - suite: summarizer-v3-prompts
  - delta: rouge-l -4.2%, human-signal regression on 6/50
  - suggested actions: pin previous model v2.3.0 / bisect v2.3.1 / partial route split
  - logs: https://releases.redwood.ai/preflight/4387650001/logs

alex: are the failures concentrated on a particular prompt type or length? noisy tail or systemic?

mira: looks systemic across long-context and multi-bullet summaries. not just the tail — a pattern in paragraph condensation tests.

jordan: i'm +1 rollback to v2.3.0. safer to pause and investigate than risk user regressions during window.

sara: we could do a partial region pin (EU only) and keep US on canary, but that still needs product signoff and ops orchestration.

paul: technically we can split routes: /route set summarizer: model=v2.3.0 region=eu traffic=100%; region=us traffic=10% v2.3.1 rest. needs a quick approval and I'll run the change.

liz: product POV — users are seeing hallucinations on billable features; i'd prefer rollback unless ops confirms partial reduces user exposure immediately.

mira: if rollback, what's the procedure? downtime or session impact?

paul: no downtime. new sessions will be routed to pinned model. session affinity preserved for existing sessions. ETA ~12-15m to promote pin and validate.

oliver: product signoff for rollback. proceed with pin. make sure release notes call out regression and mitigation. open a follow-up ticket for bisect.

mira: ok doing it now. /deploybot pin summarizer v2.3.0 --reason "preflight eval regression"

deploybot: ack. pin job queued by mira. job_id=rb-20240321-4387650001. status: running. logs: https://releases.redwood.ai/jobs/rb-20240321-4387650001/logs

alex: capture the 6 failing samples into eval-bisect bucket pls. i'll start bisect on v2.3.1 to find delta point.

sara: i'll open hotfix branch for tokenizer/anchoring edge cases that look related to long-context collapse.

mira: holding current release. rollback/pin in progress. i'll update release notes and post in #incidents once pin is done. thanks all :thumbsup:

paul: once pin finishes, we'll run a smoke sweep across top 100 routes and confirm latency/cost.

mira: last note — we should add this prompt subset to the permanent alerting suite. filed: https://tickets.redwood.ai/PRJ-9842

mira: thread closed when pin completes.
